candidates.title: Will it rain in New Orleans on Nov 22, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the total precipitation at CLIMSY in New Orleans in Nov 22, 2026 is strictly greater than 0 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Data for CLIMSY can be found at https://weather.com/kalshi.
“Trace” amounts (T) and missing daily precipitation values are counted as 0 inches.

candidates.title: Will the maximum temperature be 40-41° on Nov 23, 2026?

Preliminary Weather Company data may be subject to rounding and conversion differences from the final reported value.
Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.

candidates.title: Will there be at least 40 presidential nominations sent to the Senate in the week of Nov 22, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has sent at least 40 nominations to the U.S. Senate from Nov 22, 2026 through Nov 28, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov before 10:00 AM ET on Nov 29, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The market solely resolves to the publication dates visibly displayed on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov before 10:00 AM ET on Nov 29, 2026.
The week runs from Nov 22, 2026 through Nov 28, 2026.

Payout criteria

If a person receives multiple qualifying nominations within the period, they will each count separately.
For example, Trump's March 4 nomination of Kevin Warsh is considered two nominations.

candidates.title: Will the Democratic party win the Senate in 2028?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Democratic party has won control of the Senate in 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market may be determined early based on a consensus of media calls projecting control of the U.S. Senate. See full rules for details. Otherwise, victory will be determined by the party identification of the President pro tempore of the Senate on February 1, 2029.

candidates.title: Will the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, for November 27, 2026 be above $1.10?
candidates.rules_primary: If the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, as reported in the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report scheduled for publication on November 27, 2026 is above $1.10, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market uses advertised retail prices, not transaction prices. The relevant value is the “This Week” Wtd Avg Price for the row with Commodity “Avocados,” Variety “Hass,” and Unit “each” in the National Conventional Summary section of the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report. Prices for other avocado varieties, sizes, package counts, organic avocados, regional tables, “Last Week,” or “Last Year” do not count.

candidates.title: Will the rate of CPI inflation be above 4.2% for the year ending in December 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than 4.2% in the twelve months ending December 2026 (as represented by the one-decimal place value reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics), then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown

candidates.title: Will Trump nominate Kevin Hassett as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.rules_primary: If Kevin Hassett is nominated as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027. then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: Official announcements made by the President (or President-elect) of Kevin Hassett's nomination shall satisfy the Payout Criterion, even if they are not yet sent to the Senate.

candidates.title: Will Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: U.S. city average, All items, not seasonally adjusted, 1982–84=100 for November 2026 be above 335.900?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: U.S. city average, All items, not seasonally adjusted, 1982–84=100 for November 2026 is above 335.900, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The Underlying is the Bureau of Labor Statistics’ Consumer Price Index News Release Table 1 for November 2026. Specifically, the value used will be the “All items” value under the “Unadjusted indexes” column for November 2026. This market will resolve according to the first value published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics in the scheduled Consumer Price Index release for November 2026. Subsequent revisions will not affect the market.

candidates.title: Will a bill ending self rule in Washington DC become law before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.yes_sub_title: A bill ending self rule in Washington DC
candidates.rules_primary: If a bill ending self rule in Washington DC becomes law before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

candidates.title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2027 be above 5.5%?
candidates.rules_primary: If the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2027 is above 5.5%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The initially reported value for December 2027 will be used. This market concerns the 12-month percentage change for December 2027, not the annual-average percentage change for the specified year.
